record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

And thou shalt set<WH07760><WTH8804> them in two<WH08147> rows<WH04634>, six<WH08337> on a row<WH04635>, upon the pure<WH02889> table<WH07979> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>.

And thou shalt put<WH05414><WTH8804> pure<WH02134> frankincense<WH03828> upon <FI>each<Fi> row<WH04635>, that it may be on the bread<WH03899> for a memorial<WH0234>, <FI>even<Fi> an offering made by fire<WH0801> unto the LORD<WH03068>.

Every sabbath<WH07676> he shall set it<WH03117> in order<WH06186><WTH8799> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> continually<WH08548>, <FI>being taken<Fi> from the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> by an everlasting<WH05769> covenant<WH01285>.

And it shall be Aaron's<WH0175> and his sons<WH01121>'; and they shall eat<WH0398><WTH8804> it in the holy<WH06918> place<WH04725>: for it <FI>is<Fi> most<WH06944> holy<WH06944> unto him of the offerings<WH0801><WH00> of the LORD<WH03068> made by fire<WH0801> by a perpetual<WH05769> statute<WH02706>.<CM>

And the son<WH01121> of an Israelitish<WH03482> woman<WH0802>, whose father<WH01121> <FI>was<Fi> an Egyptian<WH0376><WH04713>, went out<WH03318><WTH8799> among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478><WH03481>: and this son<WH01121> of the Israelitish<WH03482> <FI>woman<Fi> and a man<WH0376> of Israel<WH03478> strove together<WH05327><WTH8735> in the camp<WH04264>;

And the Israelitish<WH03482> woman's<WH0802> son<WH01121> blasphemed<WH05344><WTH8799> the name<WH08034> <FI>of the LORD<Fi> , and cursed<WH07043><WTH8762>. And they put<WH03240><WTH8686> him in ward<WH04929>, that the mind<WH06310> of the LORD<WH03068> might be shewed<WH06567><WTH8800> them. <RF>that...: Heb. to expound unto them according to the mouth of the LORD<Rf>
And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Bring forth<WH03318><WTH8685> him that hath cursed<WH07043><WTH8764> without<WH02351> the camp<WH04264>; and let all that heard<WH08085><WTH8802> <FI>him<Fi> lay<WH05564><WTH8804> their hands<WH03027> upon his head<WH07218>, and let all the congregation<WH05712> stone<WH07275><WTH8804> him.

And thou shalt speak<WH01696><WTH8762> unto the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Whosoever<WH0376> curseth<WH03588><WH07043><WTH8762> his God<WH0430> shall bear<WH05375><WTH8804> his sin<WH02399>.

And he that blasphemeth<WH05344><WTH8802> the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068>, he shall surely<WH04191><WTH8800> be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714>, <FI>and<Fi> all the congregation<WH05712> shall certainly<WH07275><WTH8800> stone<WH07275><WTH8799> him: as well the stranger<WH01616>, as he that is born in the land<WH0249>, when he blasphemeth<WH05344><WTH8800> the name<WH08034> <FI>of the LORD<Fi> , shall be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714>.
And he<WH0376> that killeth<WH05221><WTH8686> any<WH05315> man<WH0120> shall surely<WH04191><WTH8800> be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714>. <RF>killeth...: Heb. smiteth the life of a man<Rf>

And he that killeth<WH05221><WTH8688> a beast<WH0929>, he shall restore<WH07999><WTH8762> it: and he that killeth<WH05221><WTH8688> a man<WH0120>, he shall be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714>.
Ye shall have one<WH0259> manner of law<WH04941>, as well for the stranger<WH01616>, as for one of your own country<WH0249>: for I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.

And Moses<WH04872> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> to the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, that they should bring forth<WH03318><WTH8686> him that had cursed<WH07043><WTH8764> out<WH02351> of the camp<WH04264>, and stone<WH07275><WTH8799> him with stones<WH068>.
